picks.title: Coinbase Customer Data Hit in Analytics Vendor Breach, Funds ‘Not Impacted’
picks.summary: The incident at analytics firm Amplitude hit a small subset of Coinbase customers, the exchange said, without saying how many.

picks.title: Coinbase Denies Systems Breach, Cites Amplitude Contact-Data Incident

picks.title: Bithumb Says Hackers Accessed Internal System, Leaking Personal Data

picks.title: Hackers now scanning systems for recently-patched Oracle flaw

picks.title: Nefilim and Hive ransomware affiliate gets 70 months in prison
picks.summary: A Ukrainian national was sentenced to 70 months in prison for his role in ransomware attacks targeting hospitals, government entities, and high-revenue businesses worldwide between 2018 and 2021. [...]

picks.title: Tranche Vault on Avalanche Drained of 1.01 Million USDC
